newsitem.title: FRANCE: France expels illegal Romanian immigrants.
newsitem.headline: France expels illegal Romanian immigrants.

text.p: France expelled 31 Romanian illegal immigrants to their home country on Thursday, 10 of whom had recently been released from jail, the Interior Ministry said.
A ministry statement said the group were flown from Roissy-Charles de Gaulle airport north of Paris on a specially-chartered plane from Romania's state-owned Tarom airlines.
It was the 30th such expulsion of illegal immigrants since President Jacques Chirac took power early last year. France has expelled 18,882 illegal immigrants since May, 1995, the ministry said.
